notes.title: Notice of price increase for Outside the Window
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Sorry to inform you of something!

Due to the problem of bundles, the bundle will not be visible when double discounts are applied.
The average price of the items in the bundle must reach the minimum transaction price of each currency on Steam (adjusted to $0.49 per currency).
If the average price of the items in the bundle is lower than this minimum price, the bundle will not be available in this country/region.
"Outside the Window" has always set the lowest price on Steam, which will cause my author bundle to disappear.
So "Outside the Window" has been temporarily removed from the bundle.

After this discount, the price will increase slightly, probably at the same price as "Mouse People".

Liujiajun
April 20, 2025

notes.title: New game about OCD "Balance 100" will be available on the Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone:


I recently wanted to introduce you to my new work "Balance 100", the demo will be available on June 19 during the Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219190/

[h1][b]Game Description[/b][/h1]

This is a precise placement game that requires both hands to operate. The game will be available on Steam on July 17.

[previewyoutube=b5KV1fde7BA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]About the Steam Next Fest[/b][/h1]

The game will be released in the recent New Products Festival demo, so that you players to go free experience, while the new festival demo will be than the prologue to provide another two new small mode.
[olist]
[*] Endless mode, players can be in the endless mode, and constantly have to generate the cat into its litter, to reach the ultimate boredom!
[*] Electromagnetic Maze, where players need to help ghost cats dodge obstacles and finally ascend safely to the sky to feel the ultimate heartbeat!
[/olist]

[previewyoutube=l2gAS7bXSFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Finally[/b][/h1]
I am completely self-researching and self-publishing this "Balance 100", so the release publicity is limited, so I hope you will help and promote it.
Please Wishlist Balance 100, and give me the Triforce to develop more interesting and very new Gameplay triangle, I am also very willing to explore more possibilities of game development with you players.


See you soon!


LiuJiajun

notes.title: 《Outside the Window》 Updata 1.0.0.8
notes.notes:
Version: 1.0.0.8

The update patches 1-7 were pushed at one time.

Dear players:

[olist]
[*] Fixed the garbled problem when the score is lower than 0.
[*] Fixed the problem of repeated stacking of buildings that are too high. Now the buildings have a maximum height.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving left and right could embed other buildings.
[*] Score predictions for pre-drop can now be displayed.
[*] Fixed the problem that the villain would be stuck in the air and rotate during the cutting process.
[*] Added achievement system.
[*] Fixed camera function.
[*] Modified Standard Mode and Zen Mode.
[*] Added controller support.
[*] Added tutorial icon to start menu.
[*] Added curtains.
[*] Added sound effects to selection blocks.
[*] Added sound effects to block appearance.
[*] Modified an icon error on the main page.
[*] Switching languages ​​is now displayed instantly.
[*] Added Traditional Chinese and Japanese (machine translation).
[*] Modified the score required to level up in Hell Mode.
[*] Added the next score level in the settlement of Hell Mode.
[*] Modified the display of points in Hell Mode, now if you have enough points to pass the level, the points bar will turn green.
[*] Game engine updated with some new adaptations.
[*] Fixed some textual errors.
[/olist]

Happy gaming everyone.


liujiajun
August 4, 2022
